info.title: sourcegraph-mcp — live code source graph MCP server for .NET
info.description: 🌿 Live code source graph MCP server for .NET solutions. Indexes C#/Roslyn into SQLite + FTS5 and exposes graph queries (find_definition, find_references, list_callers, neighborhood, impact_of_change, find_diagnostics, list_generated_files, list_tests_for, who_authored, recent_changes, ...) over stdio MCP. Watches the filesystem for incremental updates. v0.4 adds optional code-aware semantic_search backed by ONNX embeddings + sqlite-vec (gated behind --no-embeddings), Roslyn diagnostics indexing, source-generator document tracking, test-method discrimination + Tests edges, and per-symbol git blame history.

options.name: --root
options.description:
Repository root used for `.sourcegraph.json` discovery and scope DBs.
Defaults to the directory holding `--solution`, then CWD.

options.name: --model
options.description:
Override the embedding model identity (default:
jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code). Applies to serve/index.

options.name: --no-embeddings
options.description:
Skip the embedding pipeline entirely. semantic_search returns the
disabled-message; every other tool works as before.

options.name: --no-model-download
options.description:
Disable auto-fetching the embedding model from Hugging Face. With this
flag the pipeline runs only when the cache is already populated;
otherwise it degrades to the same shape as --no-embeddings. Use in
air-gapped environments where outbound network is denied. Equivalent
to setting SOURCEGRAPH_NO_MODEL_DOWNLOAD=1.

options.name: --no-history
options.description:
Disable the git-blame history pipeline. Use in environments without
git on PATH or in CI runs where per-symbol history isn't needed.
--no-instructions Don't publish server-side usage guidance in the MCP `initialize`
response. Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_NO_INSTRUCTIONS=1.

options.name: --no-leaf
options.description:
Don't prefix tool responses (or the published `ServerInstructions`
string) with the green-leaf brand mark. Equivalent to setting
SOURCEGRAPH_NO_LEAF=1.

options.name: --scope
options.description:
Restrict the operation to a single scope. Currently consumed by
`vocabulary list`; ignored elsewhere.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Treat warnings as errors. Currently consumed by `vocabulary list`,
which exits 2 on drift candidates when set.

options.name: --query-timeout-seconds
options.description:
Statement timeout (seconds) for the `query_graph` MCP tool. Default 5.
Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=<int>.

options.name: --query-row-limit
options.description:
Maximum rows returned by a `query_graph` call. Default 5000. The tool
returns up to <int> rows and reports `truncated: true` if more matched.
Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_QUERY_ROW_LIMIT=<int>.

options.name: --db
options.description: ./.sourcegraph/scopes/default.db   (created if missing; legacy graph.db is migrated)

Skip the embedding pipeline entirely. semantic_search returns the
disabled-message; every other tool works as before.

options.name: --no-model-download
options.description:
Disable auto-fetching the embedding model from Hugging Face. With this
flag the pipeline runs only when the cache is already populated;
otherwise it degrades to the same shape as --no-embeddings. Use in
air-gapped environments where outbound network is denied. Equivalent
to setting SOURCEGRAPH_NO_MODEL_DOWNLOAD=1.

options.name: --no-history
options.description:
Disable the git-blame history pipeline. Use in environments without
git on PATH or in CI runs where per-symbol history isn't needed.
--no-instructions Don't publish server-side usage guidance in the MCP `initialize`
response. Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_NO_INSTRUCTIONS=1.

options.name: --no-leaf
options.description:
Don't prefix tool responses (or the published `ServerInstructions`
string) with the green-leaf brand mark. Equivalent to setting
SOURCEGRAPH_NO_LEAF=1.

options.name: --scope
options.description:
Restrict the operation to a single scope. Currently consumed by
`vocabulary list`; ignored elsewhere.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Treat warnings as errors. Currently consumed by `vocabulary list`,
which exits 2 on drift candidates when set.

options.name: --query-timeout-seconds
options.description:
Statement timeout (seconds) for the `query_graph` MCP tool. Default 5.
Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=<int>.

options.name: --query-row-limit
options.description:
Maximum rows returned by a `query_graph` call. Default 5000. The tool
returns up to <int> rows and reports `truncated: true` if more matched.
Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_QUERY_ROW_LIMIT=<int>.

options.name: --db
options.description: ./.sourcegraph/scopes/default.db   (created if missing; legacy graph.db is migrated)

options.name: --root
options.description:
Repository root used for `.sourcegraph.json` discovery and scope DBs.
Defaults to the directory holding `--solution`, then CWD.

options.name: --model
options.description:
Override the embedding model identity (default:
jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code). Applies to serve/index.
